comments.why: Sid Meier on negative random events and player experience.
comments.text: Agreed; the point of the game is to make you feel like a God. Sid Meier gave a talk at the GDC: [VIDEO] In it he explained how Civilization tested random negative events that could shape your world. He mentioned how this had a negative effect on the player experience and many times people would just grab a past save to avoid them IIRC.
